catalogueIntro: Explore evidence-informed information about two weight-management medicines. This is not a recommendation or offer to supply.
dashboardNextBody: Read treatment information and follow your requests in one place.
getItNowNote: Opens a request for administrator review — not a purchase or prescription.
semaglutideShort: A GLP-1 receptor agonist studied for long-term weight management alongside lifestyle support.
tirzepatideShort: A GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist studied for long-term weight management alongside lifestyle support.
exampleDose: Illustrative {dose} stage · not a dose-specific quote
cardReferenceNote: Uses the first monthly price tier; not a dose-specific quote or personal dose advice.
pricesIntro: These are administrator-managed illustrative references, not a quote or offer. They do not establish suitability or access to medicine.
doseScheduleIntro: An illustrative escalation example paired with the current reference price tier.
tirzepatideSharedTier: The 12.5 mg and 15 mg example stages both use the configured month-5+ price tier. That tier is not a dose-specific price or a rule to increase dose.
doseScheduleCaution: This is a general illustration, not your dose schedule. A qualified prescriber must decide whether a medicine, dose or change is appropriate; progression may be delayed, different or not occur.
priceScope: These references cover the treatment amount only. Delivery, prescribing, consultation and other services are not included unless separately confirmed. Actual arrangements and prices may differ.
semaglutideHow: Semaglutide acts on GLP-1 receptors involved in appetite and food intake. It is used under an appropriate prescribing and monitoring process.
tirzepatideHow: Tirzepatide acts on both GIP and GLP-1 receptors involved in appetite and food intake. It is used under an appropriate prescribing and monitoring process.
semaglutideEvidence: Trials in studied adult populations found meaningful average weight reduction alongside lifestyle support. Individual responses vary, and trial averages do not predict your result.
tirzepatideEvidence: Trials found meaningful average weight reduction alongside lifestyle support. In one head-to-head trial of adults with obesity without diabetes, average reduction exceeded semaglutide; this does not determine individual suitability.
precautionsBody: Nausea, vomiting and digestive effects are common. Serious adverse effects can occur. Pregnancy plans, existing conditions and other medicines require independent professional assessment. Seek urgent medical advice for severe persistent abdominal pain.
storageBody: Storage depends on the exact licensed formulation and pack supplied. Follow its current official leaflet and pharmacist's instructions; do not infer storage life from these concept images. No product-specific laboratory certificate is available here.
requestIntro: Confirm your contact details and delivery address.
whatNextMessage: You'll receive an email confirming your request and explaining how to proceed with payment when applicable.
whatNextSecondary: Dispatch details will be confirmed once the necessary authorisation and supply requirements are complete.
orderDisclaimer: This sends a request for administrator review. It is not a purchase, prescription or confirmation of medicine supply.
requestReceivedBody: Your request has been recorded. You'll receive information about the next steps by email. This is not a confirmed purchase or prescription.
invalidPostcode: Enter a valid UK postcode, for example M1 1AE.
invalidTelephone: Enter a valid UK telephone number, for example 07700 900123.
reviewNote: Check everything before submitting. You can go back to correct it.
invalid: Please complete all required fields with valid details.
saveFailed: Your request could not be saved. Please try again.
rateLimited: Too many requests today. Please try again later.
received: Your request has been received. We'll review the information and contact you about the next steps.
requestsIntro: Follow the progress of your requests and continue the conversation privately.
empty: You haven't submitted a treatment-access request yet.
statusCaution: This status does not establish clinical suitability, a prescription or permission to supply medicine.
adminIntro: Review submitted requests and record administrative next steps.
strengthAdminNote: This is an administrative selection only, not a dose recommendation or prescription.
decisionRequired: Choose Approved or Declined before sending.
decisionInvalid: For approval, select a product and configured strength. For decline, add a short response.
alreadyFinal: This request has a final decision and cannot be changed.
approvalEmailNotConfigured: The approval was saved, but email is not configured. Check Resend and the public application URL, then retry Send.
approvalEmailNotVerified: The approval was saved, but the member’s account email is not verified. No notice was sent.
approvalEmailRejected: The approval was saved, but the email provider did not accept the message. Check configuration and retry Send.
approvalEmailUncertain: The approval was saved, but email submission is uncertain. Retry Send safely; duplicate delivery is prevented.
notificationNote: An approval sends a status notice to the verified account address. Payment instructions require a separate verified prescribing and lawful supply step.
approvedMemberTitle: Your treatment request has been approved for next steps
approvedMemberBody: We’ll contact you shortly with payment instructions and next steps. This administrative approval is not a prescription or a determination of medical suitability.

payment.title: Payment instructions
payment.description: Send only after independently verifying the prescription and lawful supply authorisation. Administrative approval alone does not permit a payment request.
payment.priceMissing: No exact-strength price is configured. Set it in Admin → Pricing before continuing.
payment.prescribingVerified: I have verified an applicable prescription from an authorised prescriber.
payment.supplyVerified: I have verified lawful supply authorisation for this exact product and strength.
payment.confirm: Send the payment instructions to the member’s verified email address?
payment.sent: Payment instructions were submitted to the email provider.
payment.attemptExists: A payment-email attempt already exists. Check its status before any further action; an uncertain submission must be reconciled manually.

errors.PAYMENT_AUTHORISATION_REQUIRED: Enter both verification references and confirm both checks.
errors.BANK_DETAILS_NOT_CONFIGURED: Configure valid bank account details in the application environment.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Configure Resend, sender and public app URL.
errors.STRENGTH_PRICE_MISSING: No exact-strength price is configured. Set it in Admin → Pricing.
errors.PAYMENT_ALREADY_SENT: Payment instructions have already been sent.
errors.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_EXISTS: A previous payment-email attempt exists. Reconcile its delivery status before retrying.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_VERIFIED: The member account is inactive or its email is unverified.
errors.PAYMENT_EMAIL_REJECTED: The email provider rejected the payment message. No automatic retry was made.
errors.PAYMENT_SUBMISSION_UNCERTAIN: Email acceptance is uncertain. Check Resend before taking further action.
errors.GENERIC: Could not prepare payment instructions. Check the request and try again.

payment.failed: The email provider rejected the instructions. Check the sender configuration. This attempt is locked to prevent duplicate payment requests; reconcile it before another send.
payment.uncertain: Email acceptance is uncertain. Check Resend before taking further action; do not send again automatically.
payment.inProgress: A payment email attempt is in progress. Check Resend if it remains here.
